session.what: a Claude Code terminal session started in a checkout of this repository (also its subagents)

codex.what: a Codex terminal session started in a checkout of this repository (Codex loads AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md's generated copy, from the project root down to its launch folder)

agent.what: the Discord dev agent (claude -p --restricted in a job worktree; CLAUDE.md is not loaded for it)
